notes:
T903 all-claims evidence race lane (deepseek-v4-pro). Audited EVERY row in docs/epistemic/CLAIMS.md (233 rows parsed, matching weizigo-claimlint's row count) in file order, in 12 batches of 20, each batch written as one JSONL object per line to the lane directory (git-ignored; named here by description only, never as a path, per the commit-gate rule). Per-claim verdicts, confidence, cited paths, what I checked and notes live in those batch files; this findings file records the aggregates.

Five verdict counts (n=233): BACKED 92, PROSE-ONLY 125, ADJACENT 13, UNCHECKABLE 3, DANGLING 0. Confidence distribution: high 43, medium 147, low 43.

Verdict rules applied (stated so another lane can disagree explicitly): BACKED = the cited committed artifact, when opened, actually contains the load-bearing content (raw probe output whose numbers match the claim; a committed proof/derivation; source lines that do what a code claim says; the ADR/decision text for documentary claims). PROSE-ONLY = the citation is a report document (EPISTEMIC.md, PROGRESS.md, research notes, findings JSON, ADR prose) asserting a measured result with no committed probe output behind it. ADJACENT = a committed artifact that establishes something near-but-not-the claim (a probe source without its committed output; a theorem note cited for an implementation claim or vice versa; a measurement at a different scope; a cited source that mechanizes a superseded predicate). DANGLING = cited path does not resolve at HEAD. UNCHECKABLE = could not open or interpret the artifact (here: the 518MB WZO2 binaries). For rows whose status is UNTESTED/INTRACTABLE/(definition), the row asserts a *status*, not a result; I marked those BACKED when the cited doc genuinely flags that status, and said so in the row note.

Every cited path was resolved at HEAD before writing (0 non-resolving cited paths in the final batches). I opened and checked the load-bearing outputs for the BACKED-high rows: GLOBAL-S3a kernel/legal-count logs (0/570; all six sizes), consist-3x2 log (45/378 writes-ON, 0 writes-OFF, 0 deps), GLOBAL-FP1/INVSYM proofs, GLOBAL-FP3 probe, ADR-0006 eye-prune stdout (Sections A-J), H1-CENSUS 4x4-standard.txt, QA-026 4x4 exp6 stdout (root V=1, 31 sweeps), T13 re-implementation (154/508, §8), I11 PROVENANCE, and the T380/T387/T309 findings.

Where I was weakest (honest read): (1) The 125 PROSE-ONLY rows were classified by a principled rule (report-vs-raw-output) rather than by opening all ~700 cited artifacts; a lane that opened every research/findings doc may split PROSE-ONLY from ADJACENT differently, and I did not re-derive any measurement. (2) The 92 BACKED rows are graded on citation content, not on whether I independently re-ran a probe — my confidence reflects how much I opened, not how much I re-executed. (3) The theorem/decision/documentary rows (BACKED for ADR/proof/code) sit at the boundary of the closed verdict list; another lane may reasonably call the literature-note theorem rows (e.g. GLOBAL.S2 'cited, not proved here') PROSE-ONLY rather than accepting the citation. (4) I made no attempt to re-derive the 4x4 exhaustive WZO2 measurements (UNCHECKABLE) — a lane with the oracle-v2 reader built could convert some UNCHECKABLE rows to BACKED or ADJACENT. (5) My confidence on UNTESTED/INTRACTABLE rows is uniformly low/medium and reflects status-claim fidelity, not the proposition.

No claim status changes proposed (this lane is an audit, not an adjudication; the register does not edit on a lane's authority, and the brief forbids committing).
